title.native: ランス・アンド・マスクス

description:
Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendent of the “Knights of the World.” With the Knight’s Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as “Knight Lancer” but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description: Raised in an old knight family and being a new member of the last knight order, Youtarou has a specific version of middle school syndrome. Whenever he sees a damsel in distress, he can't stop but saving her in an awesome way, only to make fool of himself by acting way too chivalric. He fights with a lance and wears masque so people won't recognize him. He also rides on a horse which turns into a... loli?

The female protagonist. Daughter of a prominent family, she lives alone and Youtarou watches over her. She loves the idea of heroes who fight for justice and never bow for anyone. For some time she wanted to be a hero herself, and trained every day. After she fell while training, Youtarou saved her in disguise. Since then she's adored her Knight Lancer, but doesn't realize the pathetic Youtarou is the same person. After some time, she decides that rather than becoming a hero, she will instead become a great Lady that Knight Lancer can be proud to protect.
A maid and Youtarou's stern mentor. Her iron fist has guided his training since childhood, to the point that he blames her for his White Knight Syndrome.

name.native: アリス・クリーヴランド

node.description: A bright and cheerful knight apprentice who serves as Youtarou's squire.
